== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An [[Icon]] serves as a representation of a potent concept, where an individual's effectiveness is determined by how well they embody that specific idea. The [[dragons|Dragon]] [[Icon]] provides a unique form of [[Authority|authority]] that can be integrated into various techniques, such as [[Black dragons|black dragon]]-fire or [[blood madra]] constructs. This [[Authority|authority]] grants users strength that can bypass the standard laws of reality and is often accompanied by a distinct internal sensation described as a song. The essence of the [[dragons|Dragon]] [[Icon]] is tied to an inherent sense of certainty and arrogance, reflecting the nature of a superior being. Visually, the [[Icon]] can manifest in several ways, including as a dark, twisting serpentine image in the sky or a realistic [[Black dragons|black dragon]] covering a surface. It is also associated with specific entities like the [[Weeping Dragon]], which utilizes blue and gold lightning to consume spirits for a [[Dreadgod]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[dragons|Dragon]] [[Icon]] is an icon carrying [[Authority|authority]] from [[Northstrider]] that displays the realistic image of a long, serpentine [[Black dragons|black dragon]]. During combat, it appeared behind a technique to add its [[Authority|authority]] onto a [[Path]] of [[Black dragons|black dragon]]-fire while resonating with the [[Strength Icon]]. This icon sings a song within [[Lindon]] and provides him with stolen [[Authority|authority]] that rages through his body, granting him strength that defies the rules of the world. Although it possesses no [[Authority|authority]] over healing, its power can assist [[Mercy]] and allowed [[Orthos]] to shoot [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] with its touch. When [[Lindon]] glared at [[Reigan Shen]], his gaze held the combined intensity of both the [[dragons|Dragon]] and Void [[Icons]].}}
